covers: rcamera.h's UpdateCamera in each mode (free, first person, third person, orbital, custom) from three starts over scripted input frames (frames.txt: mouse, keys, pan, wheel, gamepad), each 1/60 s; raylib's rcamera built alone, its input functions stubbed
notes: Sections by mode (m0 custom, m1 free, m2 orbital, m3 first person, m4 third person). raylib's rcamera works in floats, helix-ray in doubles: over 32 frames of large moves the two drift apart by up to 1e-3 (first and third person), where raylib's rcamera built in doubles matches helix-ray to 2e-7.
